description.zh:
账号锁定状态。取值范围：

- **UnLock**：未锁定。
- **Lock**：锁定。
description.en:
The lock status of the account. Valid values:

- **UnLock**: The account is not locked.

- **Lock**: The account is locked.
The name of the database account.

description.zh: 账户有效日期，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ，表示到指定时间账号过期
description.en: The expiration time of the account. The time must be in the \`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ\` format.

description.zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to view the details of all clusters in a region, including cluster IDs.

title.zh: 修改PolarDB数据库账号的锁定状态。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-account-lock-state --db-cluster-id pc-000 --account-name your_account_name --account-lock-state Lock --account-password-valid-time 2026-09-17T10:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ModifyAccountLockState --region cn-hangzhou --AccountLockState Lock --DBClusterId 'pc-000' --AccountPasswordValidTime '2026-09-17T10:00:00Z' --AccountName your_account_name
